wts_scope: Actual HWND software messages, real GetLastInputInfo/SendInput and five-minute idle. Synthetic operator input during transfers; physical Win+L/Hello/TPM remain NOT_RUN

updater.scope: Ephemeral maintained CLI signatures over HTTPS, claims/payload tampering denied, actual next-version installer launched, existing encrypted SQLite retained and exact fresh-process draft read

signing: Unsigned development installer; synthetic updater signatures only; no production release claim
